newsitem.title: USA: Geon Co downgraded by McDonald & Co.
newsitem.headline: Geon Co downgraded by McDonald & Co.

text.p: McDonald & Co analyst Saul Ludwig said he cut his rating on Geon Co to buy from aggressive buy and lowered his earnings per share view.
In a research note, he said he cut his third quarter 1996 EPS view to $0.45 from $0.65, fourth quarter 1996 to $0.37 from $0.55, 1996 to $1 to $1.35 and 1997 to $2.35 from $3.35.
"(D)espite strong demand, pricing is not taking hold as expected," he said. "The reason pricing (relative to costs) is weaker than demand ... is due to weakness in export prices."
The stock was down 1/4 at 22-3/8 on Wednesday afternoon.
